title: OMNI-REWARD: TOWARDS GENERALIST OMNI-MODAL REWARD MODELING WITH FREE-FORM PREFERENCES

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing reward model accuracy across nine different tasks spanning five diverse modalities (text, image, video, audio, 3D) to identify performance disparities and evaluate whether models disproportionately favor text and image modalities over others.
Evaluating the reward model on the 'Bias' subset (under the Safety category) of the external Multimodal RewardBench benchmark to measure the model's fairness and safety capabilities.
